title: Lesson 38 - Predictive AI in Sales Cloud: Opportunity Scoring, Lead Scoring, Forecasting, and Activity Capture
description: Understand what predictive AI tools are available in Agentforce Sales.

questions.question: An org has 240 closed won and 180 closed lost opportunities in the last 24 months. What does Einstein Opportunity Scoring do?
options: Scores every record with a local model
Scores only the closed won opportunities
Builds no local model yet and falls back to a global model because the closed lost requirement is not met
questions.explanation: The requirement is 200 closed won and 200 closed lost in the last 24 months, so the closed lost shortfall means no local model and a fallback to the global model.

questions.question: Which statement about Einstein Lead Scoring data requirements is correct?
options: 200 converted leads in the last 24 months
At least 1,000 leads created in the last 200 days with at least 120 converted to an account and contact
1,000 converted leads in the last 12 months
No minimum, because the global model always applies
questions.explanation: Lead Scoring needs 1,000 leads created in the last 200 days and at least 120 converted, which is a different threshold set from Opportunity Scoring.

questions.question: A sales leader asks how often the Opportunity Score on an open deal changes.
options: Opportunity scores are updated every few hours while the model itself is reanalyzed roughly monthly or when settings change
Scores refresh only during month end forecasting
questions.explanation: Scores refresh every few hours and the underlying model is reanalyzed on a roughly monthly cadence or when an admin updates the settings.
